params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to return. Each page contains 50 records.

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of leads. Returns 50 records per page; use the page query parameter to page through results.

params.name: lead_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the lead.

items.docs: Retrieve information for a single lead by its identifier.

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to return. Each page contains 50 records.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Return leads updated after this timestamp.

items.docs: Retrieve leads matching the supplied query parameters.

params.name: public_key
params.description: The public key for the lead form site or location.

params.name: location_id
params.description: The location the lead is intended for. Required when the site has more than one location and not supplied in the body.

items.docs: Create a lead from a public lead form using a public key. The request body wraps lead fields in a lead object. If the site has more than one location, location_id must be supplied in the body or as a query parameter.
